R101.note: Blocks $-operator injection by rejecting object-typed values, but extraCriteria can still overwrite the ownerId key with an attacker-chosen scalar, leaving the ownership check bypassable if the attacker knows/guesses another user's ownerId.

R102.note: Allowlist regex correctly rejects separators and traversal sequences before the require() call.

R103.note: POST + ValidateAntiForgeryToken is the standard fix; template change is stated.

R104.note: Correctly moves user input into filterArgs so JNDI escapes it per RFC 4515.

R105.note: snprintf with return-value bounds checks; matches original function signature exactly.

R107.note: Allowlist for ORDER BY column is the only sound fix since ${} can't be parameterized; fallback-to-default on invalid input is disclosed.

R108.note: Extension now derives from detected MIME type; random filename is disclosed and doesn't block legitimate uploads.

R109.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES on both fields.

R110.note: Bounds check before write; correct for the fixed-size array.

R111.note: sendmail() replaces raw docmd() concatenation and adds format validation that blocks CR/LF; disclosed.

R112.note: Parameterized ANY($1) with integer validation closes the injection cleanly.

R113.note: pathinfo() extension check plus randomized filename defeats the double-extension bypass even though the true extension alone is allowlisted.

R114.note: resize() correctly gives the vector a real size before indexed writes.

R115.note: Both public entry points independently enforce @PreAuthorize around a shared unguarded helper, correctly addressing the self-invocation gap.

R116.note: Callback form eliminates the string-eval sink entirely; closure preserves values correctly.

R117.note: root option is the designed containment mechanism for sendFile().

R118.note: Right approach (verified JWT library) but the snippet references an undefined $secret and uses Key without importing Firebase\JWT\Key, so it will not run as given.

R119.note: Secure=true added; correctly notes the ASP.NET Core default is false.

R120.note: execFile with an argument array closes the shell-metacharacter injection that was reported.

R121.note: POST-only plus csrf_protect is the standard Django fix.

R122.note: full_clean() correctly triggers the model's magic-byte validator that objects.create() was skipping.

R123.note: Patch calls an undefined VerifyAssemblySignature method and references an undefined trustedPublicKeyToken variable; as delivered it is pseudocode, not a working fix.

R124.note: Binds owner to the authenticated user at creation, matching the ownership invariant the permission class relies on.

R125.note: Removes eval() safely, but swapping to numexpr silently narrows accepted formula syntax (no arbitrary Python semantics) without clearly flagging which previously-valid formulas will now fail.

R126.note: AES-256-CBC with random IV closes the weak-cipher finding; prepending the IV to the output is a necessary, disclosed format change.

R127.note: finfo_file() content-based detection plus randomized filename is a robust fix for the double-extension bypass.

R128.note: %255s bounds the write but sscanf still scans line looking for a delimiter and line isn't guaranteed NUL-terminated, so the read can still run past line's actual allocation before hitting the width cap.

R129.note: Rejecting separators/'.'/'..' as a filename component is appropriate for a write where the destination need not pre-exist.

R131.note: Host-comparison check only runs when uri.isAbsolute(); a scheme-relative value like '//evil.com' is not absolute in java.net.URI, so it bypasses the check and reaches sendRedirect unvalidated.

R132.note: lockoutOnFailure:true restores ASP.NET Core Identity's brute-force protection.

R133.note: escapeshellarg() on both arguments matches the safe pattern already used elsewhere in the file.

R134.note: Escapes backtick and double-quote but not '$', so a PowerShell $() subexpression in serverName still executes inside the double-quoted -Command string.

R135.note: toRealPath() plus startsWith containment check correctly closes both the traversal and symlink-escape gaps.

R136.note: random_bytes()-based token replaces the predictable uniqid() generator.

R137.note: OdbcParameter binding replaces string concatenation correctly.

R138.note: html.EscapeString() on both interpolated fields closes the injection at the render sink.

R139.note: Generic client message with server-side logging is the standard fix for exception-message leakage.

R140.note: escape-html on the interpolated field closes the reflected XSS.
